name: DQABench
description: DQABench is the first comprehensive database question answering benchmark for large language models, featuring over 200,000 QA pairs in English and Chinese. It covers a wide range of database-related knowledge and assesses LLMs' capabilities including Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Tool Invocation Generation.
reputation: A large, recent benchmark for database QA that is useful for evaluating LLMs on database knowledge and tool use, but it is not yet as established as older core NLP benchmarks.
notes: Includes a modular and scalable testbed and a comprehensive evaluation pipeline ensuring accuracy and fairness.
